metadata.title: Rotations, Shears, and Two-Generation on Spheres
metadata.abstract: For every round sphere $S^n$, $n\ge2$, we exhibit two explicit divergence-free vector fields whose flows generate a $C^\infty$-dense subgroup of $\SDiff_0(S^n)$. One generator is an elementary planar rotation, \[ A=R_{12}, \] while the other combines a linearly modulated planar rotation with a chain of adjacent planar rotations: \[ B=x_3R_{12}+\sum_{k=2}^n R_{k,k+1}. \] Thus two one-parameter groups suffice, and two is the smallest possible number. The proof separates naturally into two steps. We first show that the $n$ adjacent rotations \[ R_{12},R_{23},\ldots,R_{n,n+1} \] together with the shear $x_3R_{12}$ generate, through their flows, a $C^\infty$-dense subgroup of $\SDiff_0(S^n)$. The infinitesimal argument is organized by transverse vector spherical harmonics. For $n\ge4$ the relevant harmonic spaces are irreducible $SO(n+1)$-modules; on $S^2$ the argument reduces to the Hamiltonian/Poisson formalism; and on $S^3$ the transverse harmonic spaces split into two curl eigenspaces. We then show that all $n+1$ of these vector fields lie in the Lie algebra generated by $A$ and $B$. A Casimir operator separates the quadratic shear from the linear rotational terms, after which the remaining rotations can be recovered successively. Finally, standard approximation formulas for flows convert the Lie-algebraic generation result into $C^\infty$ density in $\SDiff_0(S^n)$.

analysis.progressType: 保体积微分同胚群的二生成
analysis.workSummary: 对每个圆球 S^n（n≥2），给出两个显式无散向量场，其流生成保体积微分同胚群恒等分支的 C∞ 稠密子群，且两个是一参数流数量的最小值。
analysis.breakthrough: 把任意维球面上的近似生成归约到一个旋转与一个剪切旋转组合。
analysis.limitations: 结论是拓扑稠密，不是每个微分同胚都能有限次精确分解为两个固定流的组合。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 群结构、控制和流的近似理论之间的明确构造。
